Provider icons as shown on openrouter.ai (fetched 2026-10-13), used wherever the viewer names a model's vendor (home
cards, run cards, the runs table). They come from `openrouter.ai/images/icons/`, or, for authors OpenRouter has no file
for (xAI, Z.ai, StepFun, Thinking Machines, Xiaomi, NVIDIA, MiniMax, ByteDance Seed, Amazon, Sakana, Upstage, Nous
Research, Liquid), from the Google favicon service OpenRouter's own author pages use. PNGs are downscaled to 64px.
Keyed by `vendorOf()` in `VENDOR_ICONS` (runs.js). The marks belong to their companies; shown only with `<img>`.
